description: Tamriel Rebuilt major release v26.08 titled 'Poison Song', incorporating content expansions across mainland Morrowind, Telvanni Peninsula, and revamps of classic lore.
lore_reference: Poison Song is also a famous 7-volume book series by Waughin Jarth detailing Tay, a Dunmer noble who hears the maddening song of Dagoth Ur and House Dagoth.
key_locations: Firewatch - Imperial navy stronghold on the Northern coast of mainland Morrowind
Helnim - Wealthy trading port under House Telvanni influence
Necrom - Holy city of the Dead and the Tribunal Temple
Tel Aruhn & Telvanni Isles - Ancient wizard towers of the Telvanni Lords
Roryn's Bluff - Scenic bluffs along the Padomaic Ocean
quest_guidance: For Poison Song book locations: Available across libraries in Vivec Jobasha's Rare Books, Balmora, and Telvanni wizard towers.
For Tamriel Rebuilt Poison Song content: Visit Firewatch Mages Guild and Helnim docks to start new mainland questlines.
